entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about a return. I have a VeloBand Cadence Sensor that I need to send back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and the order number?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here, delivered on December 15th. I can definitely help with this. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. The device works. It's just... I haven't been able to use it. I know I'm past the typical 30-day window, but we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My father was in the hospital for an unexpected surgery, and everything's been a bit chaotic.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope your father is recovering well.

Thank you, he's doing better. But with all that, I missed the return period. I understand a full refund might be off the table, but I was hoping we could negotiate something. Maybe a partial store credit or a discount code for a future purchase? I'd rather not be completely out the money for something I never used.
I completely understand your situation, Alex, and I appreciate you explaining. Let me just pull up our full policy here... one moment.

Okay, I have some good news. It looks like you don't need an exception at all. Our policy for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor allows for returns within 10 days of delivery. Since you received it 39 days ago, you're still unfortunately outside that timeframe for a full refund.
Oh! Really? Ninety days? I was expecting a big negotiation. That's fantastic news.

Yes, absolutely. No negotiation needed. I'm processing the return authorization for you now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the sensor back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
That's much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you so much for your help, Sarah. I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
